DO_SYSLOG.description: Set to 'yes' to force logging tests to syslog.

ABORT_NO_LINK.description: Set to 'yes' to abort scripts if the network link is not up.

DO_CABLETEST.description: Set to 'yes' to run network cable tests.

DO_ARPING.description: Set to 'yes' to test if an IPv4 or IPv6 address is already assigned.

ARP_COUNT.description: Number of ARP pings sent during ARP tests.

ARP_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout for ARP tests in seconds.
